note: Claims an LLM might make about a fixed set of passages. 'faithful' claims are supported by what they cite; 'hallucinated' ones are fabricated, mis-cited, negation-flipped, temporally wrong or uncited. The grounding checker must flag every hallucinated claim and none of the faithful ones. Expected verdicts document the mechanism that should catch each case.
